sections.label: Additions
changes: Added 23 new local games to the Silverite games library, including Basketball Stars, Bloxors, Cut the Rope, Geometry Dash, GTA 3, Happy Wheels, Mario Kart 7, Sonic CD, and more.
Every new game has a local thumbnail and opens in the Silverite game player.

sections.label: Changes
changes: Replaced the earlier local game set and the 'more games soon' teaser with the new game list.

sections.label: Fixes
changes: Removed the Truffled corner logo and link from the local game pages.

sections.label: Additions
changes: A new 'We will be adding more games soon!' card in the Silverite games library.
The local games -3, 2048, and Cut the Rope are now listed under Silverite games.

sections.label: Fixes
changes: The fullscreen button in the game player no longer renders as a pure white block.

sections.label: Additions
changes: Click the home message to swap it. Land on the same one twice for a combo.
A small br4y signature in the rail.
Press Ctrl+K for a command palette that finds pages, tabs, and games.
HomeworkBot with Studi 1.0 answers questions, reads photos, and builds quizzes in Study mode.
A model picker next to the send button switches between Studi 1.0 and your own connected model.
HomeworkBot has a cleaner chat layout with quick-start cards and Normal and Study modes.
The Discord icon on the start menu now opens Discord inside the proxy.

sections.label: Fixes
changes: Settings no longer shows grid lines through its cards.
Every game library now sorts A–Z.
